Class Tunnel

java.lang.Object
world.Tunnel
public class Tunnel extends Object
The tunnel a level is dug in: a union of corridors, chambers and shapes. Its outline gives the deadly walls, found quickly through a WallGrid, and is drawn as neon.

    • draw

      public void draw(Graphics2D g, Rectangle2D view)
      Draws the inside of the tunnel and the neon of its walls over the view. The tunnel never changes once it is dug, so it is drawn from the image tiles of a TileCache instead of being painted at every frame.
      Parameters:
      g - graphics drawing in the world
      view - the visible area, in world px
